adds.title: Loki S2#6
adds.text: As Loki relives the Citadel again and again, Sylvie keeps fighting past him to stab He Who Remains, who taunts her and freezes her in place while Loki looks for another way.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who kills him again and again as Loki relives the Citadel.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's creator, who taunts and freezes Sylvie as Loki relives the Citadel.
adds.evidence: Glorious Purpose (Loki S2#6): Loki time slips to just before Sylvie kills He Who Remains; across many loops she fights past Loki and stabs him, He Who Remains taunts her and freezes her in place with his TemPad.

adds.title: Loki S2#5
adds.text: After the Loom's explosion resets B-15 to her life as Dr. Verity Willis, Loki finds her on her timeline and brings her to A.D. Doug's workshop to help send everyone back to the TVA.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who finds her living as Verity Willis and brings her to Doug's workshop.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: TVA friend he finds living as Verity Willis and brings back.
adds.evidence: Science/Fiction (Loki S2#5): Loki slips to branches where his friends, B-15 among them, live their original lives (she as Dr. Verity Willis) and gathers them at Doug's workshop so their temporal auras can send them back.

adds.title: Loki S2#4
adds.text: Sylvie works with B-15 at the TVA to save the Loom, and when B-15 reports that Dox and her loyalists are dead, Sylvie realizes Renslayer is behind it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who works with her at the TVA to save the Loom.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hunter whose news of Dox's death points Sylvie to Renslayer.
adds.evidence: Heart of the TVA (Loki S2#4): B-15 finds Dox's loyalists crushed, tells the others, and Sylvie concludes Renslayer is responsible; both are at the Loom when Timely dies.

adds.title: Loki S2#3
adds.text: At the 1893 World's Fair, Miss Minutes poses as a ghost clock and chases Sylvie off so Renslayer can escape with Timely. Later Sylvie sends Renslayer through a Timedoor to the Citadel, and Miss Minutes goes along.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Variant she chases off at the World's Fair, who sends her and Renslayer to the Citadel.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The TVA's A.I., who chases Sylvie off at the World's Fair.
adds.evidence: 1893 (Loki S2#3): Sylvie is chased off by Miss Minutes posing as the Ghost Clock of Midway, letting Renslayer escape with Timely; at Timely's lab Sylvie sends Renslayer to the Citadel with Miss Minutes brought along.

adds.title: Loki S2#2
adds.text: Sylvie agrees to help Mobius and Loki stop Dox, and while Loki distracts the loyalists, she and Mobius destroy the TemPads setting off the reset charges.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Variant who helps him destroy Dox's TemPads.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Agent who helps her destroy Dox's TemPads.
adds.evidence: Breaking Brad (Loki S2#2): Sylvie leads Loki and Mobius to Dox's loyalists; while Loki distracts them, Mobius and Sylvie destroy the TemPads used to set off the reset charges.

adds.title: Loki S2#3
adds.text: Renslayer flees the World's Fair with Timely while Loki and Mobius chase them. At Timely's lab Loki and Mobius demand she let Timely go, and once Sylvie takes control, Loki leaves with Timely and Renslayer stays behind.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Rogue judge he chases for Timely, from the World's Fair to Timely's lab.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Variant who chases her for Timely and leaves her behind with Sylvie.
adds.evidence: 1893 (Loki S2#3): Renslayer escapes the fair with Timely and hides from Loki and Mobius; at the lab Loki and Mobius demand she let Timely go, Sylvie's blast knocks everyone over and Loki and Mobius leave with Timely, leaving Renslayer to Sylvie.

owner_calls.title: Daredevil S1
owner_calls.question: At Ben Urich's funeral (Daredevil S1#13) Karen stares accusingly at Ellison, believing he took Fisk's money and got Ben killed, and tells Matt so; no words pass between them on screen, though in S2#5 she apologizes for how she treated him there. Add an S1 stage?
options: Add rival stage at Daredevil S1#13: At Ben Urich's funeral Karen glares at Ellison, convinced he took Fisk's money and got Ben killed.
owner_calls.evidence: Mitchell Ellison fandom page, Ben Urich's Death section (DD113) and Visited by Karen Page (DD205).
